leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct an Express route handler that accepts query parameters for pagination, filtering, and sorting.
Apply query parameter parsing logic to extract and validate page, limit, and sort criteria.
Implement a filtering mechanism that dynamically builds database queries based on user-provided criteria.
Configure a sorting system that orders query results by specified fields and directions.
Manipulate a dataset to return a paginated subset using calculated skip and limit values.
Integrate pagination metadata (total pages, current page) into the API response structure.
Initialize a test suite to verify the combined functionality of pagination, filtering, and sorting endpoints.
lessonTitle: Build pagination filter sort API pattern
